purpose: The tent breathes, subtly: a PixelLab PixMiniMax loop of Home's tent (tent-home.json, the logo sprite) that starts and ends on the still. Only the roof and the pennant move: once a loop the roof's slopes lift by about a pixel and settle, and the pennant flutters every frame. The valance and its scallops, the walls, the curtains and the doorway are the still's pixels in every frame.

owner.request: 2026-10-13 ~00:50, of the 2026-10-12 loop: "the tent animation is too strong needs to be more stuble"

motion.rule: A packaged tonal pixel counts as changed when its opacity flips or its RGB moves by more than 60 in sum from the still (frame 0); percentages are of the still's 5,906 opaque pixels.

source.prompt: A quiet, seamless idle loop. The pennant flag at the top of the pole waves softly in a light breeze in every frame, and the canvas of the striped roof ripples very faintly in the same breeze, in one slow, barely perceptible rise and fall over the whole loop. The roof keeps its size and shape. The scalloped valance, the walls, the tied-back curtains and the dark doorway stay perfectly still. The tent does not move, bounce or change size. Static camera.

prompts.A: A very subtle, seamless idle loop, almost still. Only two things move: the small pennant flag at the top of the pole flutters gently in a light breeze, and the striped conical roof breathes almost imperceptibly, swelling by a single pixel and settling back. The scalloped valance, its scallops and the rope under the roof do not move. The striped walls, the tied-back curtains and the dark doorway stay perfectly still. The tent does not move, bounce, turn or change size. Static camera.
prompts.B: A calm, seamless idle loop with barely perceptible motion. The small pennant flag on top of the pole flutters gently in a soft breeze in every frame. The rest of the circus tent stays almost perfectly still: the roof breathes only very faintly, the scalloped valance and its scallops stay put, and the walls, curtains and doorway do not move at all. No bounce, no squash, no stretch. Static camera.

source.prompt: A subtle, seamless idle loop in a bouncy 1930s rubber-hose cartoon rhythm. Only the top of the circus tent moves: the striped conical roof gently breathes, swelling a little and settling back, the scalloped valance under the roof sways softly, and the small pennant flag at the top of the pole snaps and flutters in the wind. The striped walls, the tied-back curtains and the dark doorway stay perfectly still. The tent does not move, turn or change size. Static camera.
